relational_test_note: Group auditor performs an analytically distinct assurance function mediating between the competent authority's oversight regime and the reporting undertaking; not a mere recipient of the obligation.
verbatim_evidence: 1. Member States shall ensure that in the case of assurance engagements concerning the consolidated sustainability reporting of a group of undertakings: (a) [...] the group auditor bears the full responsibility for the assurance report on sustainability reporting [...]

R_actor: group auditor (acting in a coordinating/reviewing capacity)
I_actor: independent assurance services provider / subsidiary statutory auditor
relational_test_note: The group auditor evaluates and reviews the assurance work of a second, subsidiary-level provider before it feeds into the group-level assurance report - a distinct mediating function at a downstream level of the same chain, not a duplicate of CSRD-R1.
verbatim_evidence: the group auditor evaluates the assurance work performed by any independent assurance services provider(s), third-country auditor(s), statutory auditor(s), third-country audit entity(ies) or audit firm(s) for the purpose of the assurance of consolidated sustainability reporting and documents the nature [...]

I_actor: NONE - no third actor performs a mediating function in this specific provision
relational_test_note: Failed relational test: this provision only establishes the undertaking's own duty to include sustainability information in its management report. No third actor mediates the relationship - it is dyadic (R-T), not R-I-T. The intermediary (auditor) only appears in the separate assurance provisions (CSRD-R1), not here.
verbatim_evidence: 1. Large undertakings, and small and medium-sized undertakings, except micro undertakings, which are public-interest entities [...] shall include in the management report information necessary to understand the undertaking's impacts on sustainability matters [...]

R_actor: European Commission (sets criteria Art. 8; maintains public register Art. 9(10))
relational_test_note: Competent body assesses applications, verifies conformity, assigns registration numbers and contracts terms of use - a distinct mediating function between the Commission's framework and the applicant.
verbatim_evidence: 1. Any operator who wishes to use the EU Ecolabel shall apply to the competent bodies referred to in Article 4 [...] 5. [...] the competent body shall assign a registration number to the product.

I_actor: ISO 17025-accredited testing body / EN 45011-accredited verification body
T_actor: operator's product / test outcome feeding the competent body's decision
relational_test_note: The competent body itself relies on a second, independently accredited intermediary for testing/verification before it can certify - a distinct downstream mediating function, meta-regulation in the same sense as the ETS accreditation chain.
verbatim_evidence: Competent bodies shall preferentially recognise tests which are accredited according to ISO 17025 and verifications performed by bodies which are accredited under the EN 45011 standard or an equivalent international standard.

T_actor: NONE - advises the regulator, does not mediate an R-T relationship
relational_test_note: Failed relational test: the EUEB is a rule-making support body advising the Commission on criteria-setting. It does not sit between a regulator and a target in an existing obligation - it participates in rule-making itself. Excluded deliberately, not overlooked.
verbatim_evidence: Article 5 European Union Ecolabelling Board [subtitle; board established to assist the Commission in developing/revising EU Ecolabel criteria]

R_actor: not named in this article - sits elsewhere in Regulation (EU) 2016/1011 (ESMA / national competent authorities)
T_actor: companies scored for inclusion/weighting (primary); asset managers who use the label (secondary, indirect)
relational_test_note: Construct-validity question open, not resolved: the administrator selects/weights/excludes assets by a predefined decarbonisation standard (rating-like), but R is not named in this provision and T is dual/indirect. Requires discussion with David before being treated as the canonical ranking/rating case.
verbatim_evidence: Administrators of EU Climate Transition Benchmarks shall select, weight, or exclude underlying assets issued by companies that follow a decarbonisation trajectory [...] (i) the companies disclose measurable carbon emission reduction targets [...]

I_actor: verifier (accredited verification body; internal roles: lead auditor/auditor/independent reviewer)
relational_test_note: Verifier issues a verification report and is named alongside the operator and the competent authority as one of three explicit responsibility-holders in the same sentence (Art. 27(3)(j)) - the clearest textual R-I-T statement in the sample.
verbatim_evidence: (j) the responsibilities of the operator or aircraft operator, the competent authority and the verifier; [...] 2. The operator [...] shall submit the verification report to the competent authority [...]

R_actor: national accreditation body (framework per Regulation (EC) No 765/2008)
T_actor: verifier (role multiplicity: same actor is I in ETS-R1 and T here)
relational_test_note: Textbook role multiplicity: the verifier is the intermediary between competent authority and operator in ETS-R1, and simultaneously the target of its own accreditation relationship here - the same actor occupies I in one relationship and T in the linked one.
verbatim_evidence: An overall framework of rules for the accreditation of verifiers is necessary to ensure that the verification of operator's or aircraft operator's reports [...] is carried out by verifiers that [...] possess the necessary competence to fulfil their tasks.
